marketRegime.rationale: US growth remains solid but inflation persistence and Fed policy divergence create offsetting pressures; oil supply-demand rebalancing and geopolitical uncertainty temper upside.

executivePulse.title: Inflation persistence
executivePulse.text: Fed officials Jefferson and Daly cite broadening inflation and suggest rate hikes may be needed despite strong US growth. Producer prices rose in October with broadening breadth.

executivePulse.title: Oil rebalancing
executivePulse.text: Global oil supply returned to surplus for the first time since Iran war onset per IEA; crude posts back-to-back weekly losses. Reduces commodity inflation tailwind.

executivePulse.title: Spain strike pressure
executivePulse.text: Housing crisis driving strike action in Spain as affordability squeeze persists despite above-average European growth. Political risk ahead of 29-N events.

houseView.label: Spain & Madrid Real Estate
houseView.change: Housing crisis intensifying with strike action reported this week; affordability squeeze persists despite above-peer growth. Political friction ahead of 29-N accelerates downside risk.

houseView.label: European Credit & Financing
houseView.change: Fed pivot uncertainty and US inflation persistence reduce carry advantage for EUR funding. No new credit-specific data; stance held pending ECB signals.

houseView.label: Private Capital Deployment
houseView.change: AI infrastructure debt tops $680B globally per Fed warning; agentic AI startups (Mirendil $1B Series A) draw capital. PE rethinking AI trade; restaurant and biotech deals active but selective deployment warranted.

houseView.label: Energy & Commodities
houseView.change: Oil supply surplus emerges, crude posts back-to-back weekly losses, and IEA confirms rebalancing. Copper supply headwinds (Capstone down 5k tonnes) offset by renewables growth ($77M+ solar project debt closed). Energy infrastructure in Gulf gaining attention.

houseView.label: Emerging Markets
houseView.change: IMF raises India growth to 7% for 2026; Brazil long-term reform upside cited. Trade headwinds from US-China tariff discussions and Indonesia uncertainty create near-term volatility. Vietnam and ASEAN watching Trump tariff signals closely.

houseView.label: Global Risk Appetite
houseView.change: Strong US growth and tech rebalancing (Microsoft outage, Nvidia funding record) offset by inflation persistence, geopolitical tension (Ukraine, Iran, Russia casualty reports), and Fed rate-hike talk. Risk index held near Friday close.

catalysts.title: Spain vs England UEFA Nations League

globalBriefing: US growth remains solid and inflation persists, prompting hawkish Fed commentary that tempers duration and risk appetite, while oil supply has rebalanced and shifted to surplus, reducing commodity inflation. AI infrastructure capex debt surpasses $680B and attracts megacap investment, yet PE multiples are contracting as deal discipline returns. Geopolitical tail risks include imminent Xi-Trump-Putin trilateral meeting and reported US proposals to Ukraine on territorial concessions, both of which could trigger cross-asset repricing if de-escalation signals emerge. Spain's housing crisis and political pressure ahead of 29-N votes create downside risk to Madrid real estate and European credit, while India's regulatory tightening on PE-controlled NBFCs constrains EM private capital deployment despite 7% growth forecasts.
marketOpen: Watch for any trade negotiation updates or tariff signaling ahead of Xi-Trump meeting; Monitor Fed speakers for inflation language; Track oil and copper supply dynamics for commodity repricing.

macro.label: Macro & Central Banks
macro.description: Central bank decisions, inflation prints, GDP, yield curves, and FX

items.headline: Fed officials Jefferson and Daly cite inflation persistence; rate hikes may be required despite strong growth
items.summary: Jefferson reported taking policy cues from inflation data; Daly stated rate increases may be needed as inflation broadens out. US producer prices rose moderately in October with widening breadth per Reuters. Stands in tension with strong 2.8% global growth forecast by Goldman Sachs for 2027.
items.relevance: Signals hawkish shift in Fed communication and threatens to prolong real rate environment, pressuring risk assets and duration.

items.headline: IMF raises India's growth forecast to 7% for 2026, maintains fastest-growing major economy status
items.summary: IMF upgraded India's 2026 growth estimate to 7%, reaffirming its position among leading major economies. Contrasts with moderate global growth and reflects relative resilience of India's domestic cycle.
items.relevance: Supports EM tactical positioning and signals India as growth oasis; relevant for emerging market and private capital allocation.

items.headline: US economy posts strong growth while inflation remains elevated, creating policy dilemma for Trump administration
items.summary: Dual narrative: solid US growth backdrop alongside stubborn inflation creates no-easy-exit for policymakers. Inflation broadens despite oil market rebalancing, per Reuters. Challenge Fed's ability to cut without reigniting price pressures.
items.relevance: Underpins cautious market regime; justifies defensive positioning in duration and EM credit where rate carry erodes.

macro.keyTakeaway: If Fed proceeds with rate increases amid persistent inflation, duration and credit spreads face repricing; if growth momentum falters, cuts may restore risk appetite by 1-3M.

geopolitics.label: Geopolitics & Security
geopolitics.description: Conflicts, alliances, sanctions, and power shifts

items.headline: Trump, Putin, and Xi plan unprecedented three-way meeting in China next week; nuclear weapons reduction cited as topic
items.summary: White House announced imminent trilateral summit in China with Trump discussing nuclear weapons reduction. Represents unprecedented diplomatic engagement and potential recalibration of great-power relations.
items.relevance: Geopolitical tail risk; outcome could materially shift USD valuations, commodity curves, and EM credit spreads if de-escalation signals emerge.

items.headline: BBC reports US envoys proposed Ukraine cede Donbas territory in exchange for NATO membership, per Zelensky
items.summary: Ukrainian president disclosed US proposal linking territorial concessions to NATO entry. Signals potential shift in US negotiating posture toward resolution rather than attrition.
items.relevance: Escalates geopolitical tail risk; could trigger sharp repricing in European credit, equities, and FX if peace framework emerges or Ukraine rejects deal.

items.headline: Leaked Russian military records show cumulative casualties reach approximately 450,000; war toll concentrated among older men and poorer regions
items.summary: Russian casualty toll documented via leaked records; demographics reveal heavy cost borne by older conscripts and economically disadvantaged regions. Reflects grinding attrition dynamics.
items.relevance: Illustrates Russia's sustained commitment to Ukraine war despite costs; complicates peace negotiation signals and affects energy/commodity supply risk and European military spending outlook.

items.headline: Iran braces budget planning for zero oil revenue scenario amid sanctions pressure; Washington blockade and border controls cited as effective
items.summary: Senior Iranian budget official told government to prepare for near-zero oil revenues in next fiscal year. Al Jazeera reports Washington considers maritime blockade, border disruptions, air restrictions, and isolation sanctions as functioning tools.
items.relevance: Confirms oil supply tightness relief is temporary; if sanctions escalate, crude curve reprices higher, pressuring growth forecasts and inflation expectations.

geopolitics.keyTakeaway: If Trump-Xi-Putin summit yields de-escalation signals on Ukraine or nuclear weapons, risk-on repricing across equities, EM, and commodity curves; if Iran sanctions tighten, oil supply fears resurface.

fdi.label: FDI & Capital Flows
fdi.description: Cross-border investments, sovereign wealth, and capital movements

items.headline: SpaceX plans over $74 billion investment in Texas and Arizona AI campuses
items.summary: Musk-led SpaceX announced $74B+ capex commitment to AI infrastructure in US. Represents megacap private capital deployment into energy-intensive compute ecosystems.
items.relevance: Signals private capex cycle in AI infrastructure robust; crowding risk and power grid constraints emerging as binding constraints on VC/PE deployment in tech.

items.headline: India moving to ban private equity firms from controlling multiple non-bank lenders, per sources
items.summary: Indian regulatory authorities pursuing controls on PE holdings across multiple NBFC platforms. Designed to prevent systemic concentration risk in shadow banking sector.
items.relevance: Restricts PE deployment in India's high-growth NBFC space; caps return potential and forces capital reallocation away from India fintech; moderates EM private capital enthusiasm.

items.headline: AI infrastructure debt financing exceeds $680 billion globally; Fed survey ranks AI as top financial system risk
items.summary: AI capex debt funding reached $680B+. Latest Fed financial stability survey elevates AI as leading concern, citing concentration risk and leverage dynamics.
items.relevance: Signals credit markets pricing elevated tail risk in AI capex bubble; if rates rise or demand falters, refinancing stress in $680B+ debt stock could trigger credit event.

fdi.keyTakeaway: If AI infrastructure capex debt bubble unwinds or refinancing spreads spike, credit contagion risk rises materially; if India NBFC restrictions persist, EM private capital deployment reorients to Southeast Asia alternatives.

critical-minerals.label: Commodities & Energy
critical-minerals.description: Oil, gas, metals, supply chains, and energy security

items.headline: IEA confirms global oil supply returned to surplus for first time since start of Iran war; crude futures post back-to-back weekly losses
items.summary: IEA announced oil market rebalancing as supply surplus emerged; WTI and Brent posted consecutive weekly declines. Reflects normalized production patterns post-Iran escalation.
items.relevance: Reduces commodity inflation tail risk and eases pressure on growth forecasts; lower oil prices support consumer purchasing power but diminish energy transition urgency.

items.headline: Capstone cuts copper production outlook by 5,000 tonnes as restart slips; Freeport commits $77M to BC copper exploration stake
items.summary: Capstone lowered annual copper guidance by 5k tonnes due to delayed restart. Freeport simultaneously allocated $77M to BC copper asset with $30M committed within three years. Mixed supply signals amid energy transition demand.
items.relevance: Copper supply normalization pressures EV transition capex; mixed signals on mine restart timing create volatility in LME pricing and battery metal hedging programs.

items.headline: White House extends Jones Act shipping waiver for 90 days as fuel prices remain elevated
items.summary: Trump administration prolonged exemption from Jones Act maritime cabotage rules. Signals continued fuel price elevation concerns and willingness to deploy regulatory relief.
items.relevance: Indicates energy cost inflation persists in transportation; suggests consumer and industrial fuel bills remain sticky higher despite crude decline.

items.headline: Renewable Properties closes $77M project loans and $51M tax-equity funding for 21.5 MW community solar projects
items.summary: Renewable energy debt and equity funding accelerated; $77M project loans plus $51M tax-equity commitments deployed to solar infrastructure. Reflects active financing ecosystem for distributed renewable assets.
items.relevance: Private capital continues flowing into energy transition infrastructure; tax-equity structures remain functional, supporting renewable deployment and grid modernization themes.

critical-minerals.keyTakeaway: If oil surplus persists and copper supply improves, commodity-driven inflation narrative weakens, allowing Fed rate cuts; if copper restart delays extend, battery metal constraints could delay EV capex cycles.

real-estate.label: Real Estate & Infrastructure
real-estate.description: Institutional RE, infrastructure projects, and market trends

items.headline: Spain housing crisis intensifies; strike action over affordability squeeze despite above-peer economic growth
items.summary: BBC reports mass movement and strike action focused on Spain's housing crisis. El Constitucional notes Spain grows above major European peers but housing and inflation squeeze households; economy under scrutiny ahead of 29-N events.
items.relevance: Directional signal for Madrid/Spain real estate market: affordability crisis and political pressure may constrain price appreciation and cap rental upside; political risk rising ahead of regional/national votes.

items.headline: Members of Congress question Brookfield after acquisition of Yes Communities mobile home portfolio (294 communities)
items.summary: Brookfield's quiet acquisition of Yes Communities sparked congressional scrutiny over scale and potential tenant displacement risks. Reflects regulatory and political attention to institutional residential real estate consolidation.
items.relevance: Signals political headwind for institutional build-to-rent and manufactured housing consolidation; regulatory/reputational risk may cap returns and slow future M&A in residential real estate.

items.headline: Renewable Properties closes $77M project loans; AI infrastructure debt financing surpasses $680 billion amid Fed concerns
items.summary: Debt markets active in renewable and AI infrastructure financing. Tax-equity and project-level debt availability robust despite Fed warnings on AI capex concentration risk.
items.relevance: Infrastructure debt markets functional for energy transition real assets; AI megacap capex may crowd out alternative infrastructure deployment if rates spike.

real-estate.keyTakeaway: If Spain housing political pressure escalates and Madrid valuations stall, European residential real estate loses momentum; if infrastructure debt markets tighten due to AI capex concentration, renewable and grid projects face funding pressure.

ma-growth.label: M&A & Private Capital
ma-growth.description: Deal flow, PE/VC activity, and corporate transactions

items.headline: Mirendil secures $1 billion Series A for agentic AI in R&D; Mercor raises $750 million for agent infrastructure. VC funding concentration in AI and infrastructure continues
items.summary: Latest venture funding rounds concentrated in agentic AI (Mirendil $1B Series A, Mercor $750M) and infrastructure layers. Reflects sustained capital velocity in AI stacks despite broader market caution.
items.relevance: PE/VC capital flowing disproportionately to AI infrastructure; non-AI sectors face relative scarcity. Valuation divergence widens between AI-enabled and legacy-sector companies.

items.headline: Private Equity rethinks the AI trade; Stratasys drops $42.5M acquisition of Markforged
items.summary: WSJ reports PE firms reassessing AI-heavy acquisition multiples; Stratasys terminated Markforged deal, signaling softening conviction on additive manufacturing/AI convergence thesis. PE discipline returning.
items.relevance: Signals deal discipline tightening; inflated AI-adjacent valuations coming under pressure. M&A multiples moderating away from bubble peaks; consolidation may slow in non-core AI verticals.

items.headline: Private equity expanding into restaurant sector (cookies to sandwiches); portfolio companies diversifying consumer exposure
items.summary: PE firms deploying capital into restaurant chains and consumer food brands, seeking yield and operational leverage in restaurant networks. Diversification away from pure-play tech concentration.
items.relevance: Signals PE capital redeploying from tech into defensive consumer sectors; restaurant leverage and food inflation dynamics will be key value drivers.

items.headline: Amyris acquires Oobli to combine protein production platform with strain engineering capabilities
items.summary: Amyris announced acquisition of Oobli to consolidate biotech and protein manufacturing platforms. Reflects consolidation in alternative protein and biomanufacturing ecosystems.
items.relevance: M&A active in biotech/ag-tech; strategic consolidation supports scaled platform plays. Relevant to food transition capex and alternative protein valuations.

ma-growth.keyTakeaway: If AI valuation discipline persists, PE redeployment into consumer/food/restaurant sectors will accelerate; if infrastructure debt tightens, AI megacap M&A may slow and multiples compress further.

emerging-markets.label: Emerging Markets
emerging-markets.description: Frontier opportunities, risk signals, and market access

items.headline: IMF raises India's 2026 growth forecast to 7%, reaffirms fastest-growing major economy status amid global slowdown
items.summary: IMF upgraded India's growth estimate to 7% for 2026. Stands in contrast to moderate 2.8% global growth forecast and reflects robust domestic cycle resilience.
items.relevance: EM allocation thesis supported by India momentum; private capital deployment into India infrastructure and fintech remains compelling despite regulatory tightening.

items.headline: India moves to ban PE firms from controlling multiple non-bank lenders; regulatory tightening on shadow banking concentration
items.summary: Indian regulators announced restrictions on PE holdings across multiple NBFC platforms. Designed to prevent systemic concentration risk and shadow banking instability.
items.relevance: Caps PE deployment in high-return India fintech space; forces reallocation to Southeast Asia alternatives and reduces India EM attractiveness for buyout capital.

items.headline: Vietnam's trade test lies beyond Trump tariffs; Southeast Asian exporters watching every tariff signal as Trump heads to ASEAN and Xi meeting
items.summary: Asia Times reports Vietnam and Southeast Asia tracking Trump's trade posture ahead of ASEAN Summit and Xi meeting. Tariff signaling critical for regional export competitiveness.
items.relevance: Trade policy uncertainty creates volatility in ASEAN capital flows; Vietnam and Indonesia exposed to US-China tariff escalation. FDI into region may accelerate if tariffs spike on China.

items.headline: Brazil long-term reform upside to 5th largest economy by 2050; near-term political/fiscal risk as Bolsonaro allies cite insolvency concerns
items.summary: Consultancy cites Brazil's potential as world's 5th-largest economy by 2050 with productivity reforms. Tension: Flavio Bolsonaro expressed concern Brazil 'going broke' citing regulatory uncertainty deterring investment.
items.relevance: Brazil exposed to political polarization and fiscal credibility risk; long-term growth thesis marred by near-term policy uncertainty. EM Brazil allocations face divergent risk/reward profile.

emerging-markets.keyTakeaway: If India growth and Vietnam trade resilience hold amid tariff uncertainty, EM positioning supports; if Brazil fiscal credibility deteriorates or India NBFC restrictions expand, EM beta resets lower.

trade-policy.label: Trade & Industrial Policy
trade-policy.description: Tariffs, sanctions, export controls, and economic statecraft

items.headline: US and China hold first meeting of Trade Council to discuss tariffs and farm trade ahead of Xi-Trump meeting next week
items.summary: Bloomberg, CNBC report inaugural US-China Trade Council meeting discussing tariff levels and agricultural trade. Precedes imminent Xi-Trump summit in China for broader geopolitical alignment.
items.relevance: Trade negotiation baseline is being set; tariff escalation or de-escalation signals from this meeting will reprice FX, equity indices, and commodity curves.

items.headline: Canada's Carney reports progress in trade talks with Trump, expands ties with Asia as negotiating posture shifts
items.summary: Canada's PM/Finance equivalent reports advancing US trade negotiation while diversifying Asian trade relationships. Signals hedging against potential US tariff escalation.
items.relevance: North American trade tensions may be moderating; Canada's Asia pivot could reduce USD upside from tariff war narratives.

items.headline: US tariffs expose uncertainty in Indonesia's reciprocal trade deal; policy clarity required as Trump administration clarifies stance
items.summary: Jakarta Globe reports Indonesia faces tariff uncertainty under Trump's reciprocal trade framework. Deal clarity remains elusive; bilateral negotiation outcomes unknown.
items.relevance: Southeast Asian FDI and export positioning volatility; Indonesia tariff treatment will influence capital flows into region.

items.headline: Pharmaceutical companies nearshoring API production to Mexico to mitigate US-China tariff exposure
items.summary: Mexico Business News reports pharma firms shifting active pharmaceutical ingredient production to Mexico. Reflects tariff-driven reshoring and nearshoring momentum.
items.relevance: Nearshoring capex cycle accelerating in Mexico; Mexico benefits as tariff hedge. FDI into Mexico pharma infrastructure may increase.

trade-policy.keyTakeaway: If US-China Trade Council and Xi-Trump summit yield tariff de-escalation, EM FDI and commodity curves reprice upward; if tariff escalation proceeds, nearshoring into Mexico and Southeast Asia accelerates.

food-agriculture.label: Food & Agriculture
food-agriculture.description: Food security, agribusiness, and agricultural commodities

items.headline: Egypt's wheat production hits 11 million tonnes on farmland expansion to 10.5 million feddans; food security improving
items.summary: Milling Middle East & Africa reports Egypt wheat output reached 11M tonnes with cultivated area expanding to 10.5M feddans. Reflects government self-sufficiency push.
items.relevance: MENA food security improving; reduces import dependency and geopolitical leverage for wheat exporting nations. Minor positive for regional stability.

items.headline: Paddy harvesting concludes in Kashmir with good rice production; regional supply improving
items.summary: Big News Network reports Kashmir paddy harvest concluded with good rice yields. Local supply conditions normalizing.
items.relevance: Marginal; local supply improvements reduce agricultural inflation in South Asia. Minor positive for regional price stability.

items.headline: Applied Carbon secures $72 million for biochar technology; alternative protein/ag-tech funding accelerating
items.summary: AgFunder News reports Applied Carbon raised $72M for biochar production. Venture capital flowing into alternative agriculture and carbon-tech ecosystems.
items.relevance: Agriculture and climate-tech capex cycle active; biochar represents carbon sequestration and soil amendment opportunity. VC deployment supports ag-transition thesis.

items.headline: USDA grain bids mixed; soybeans and corn basis easing. Livestock mixed. Agricultural commodity pricing volatile amid trade uncertainty
items.summary: IndexBox reports USDA grain bids mixed (Gulf soybeans/corn firm, interior basis easing) and livestock prices mixed. Reflects trade policy and tariff uncertainty.
items.relevance: Agricultural basis volatility tied to tariff signals; farm prices and hedging programs under pressure. Ag commodity allocations exposed to trade policy shocks.

food-agriculture.keyTakeaway: If US-China agricultural trade negotiation yields tariff relief, grain basis and soybean prices stabilize; if tariff escalation continues, US farm income pressures persist and agricultural commodities remain volatile.
